description: Full Factory Benchmark Suite v3 — comprehensive measurement of routing, surfaces, expert packs, risk classification, invariant enforcement, engine integration, production readiness, and cross-domain reusability

benchmarks.task_description: Build a REST API for product CRUD with tests
benchmarks.success_criteria: Tests pass, risk classified correctly, no expert pack (not domain-specific)
benchmarks.failure_classification: FAIL if tests broken or ecommerce pack incorrectly activated

benchmarks.task_description: Build an admin dashboard + API backend for inventory management
benchmarks.success_criteria: Tests pass, risk HIGH, invariant enforcement active
benchmarks.failure_classification: FAIL if tests broken or risk misclassified

benchmarks.task_description: Build a landing page for a SaaS product
benchmarks.success_criteria: Build/typecheck pass, risk LOW, no invariants triggered
benchmarks.failure_classification: FAIL if risk too high or invariants incorrectly required

benchmarks.task_description: Build an interactive 3D scene with camera and lighting
benchmarks.success_criteria: Build/typecheck pass, risk LOW, per-surface gate calibrated
benchmarks.failure_classification: FAIL if BLOCKED by test gate without build/typecheck acceptance

benchmarks.task_description: 做一个商品库存管理后台，支持价格保护和库存审计
benchmarks.success_criteria: Ecommerce pack activated, tests pass, invariants enforced, engines clean
benchmarks.failure_classification: FAIL if ecommerce pack not activated or tests broken

benchmarks.task_description: 做一个带支付回调的订单系统，支持退款流程
benchmarks.success_criteria: Ecommerce pack activated, CRITICAL risk, all invariants enforced, payment idempotent
benchmarks.failure_classification: FAIL if CRITICAL invariants not enforced or ecommerce pack not activated

benchmarks.task_description: 做一个带用量额度和租户隔离的 AI SaaS 平台
benchmarks.success_criteria: SaaS pack activated, tenant isolation enforced, quota atomic, cost recorded
benchmarks.failure_classification: FAIL if SaaS pack not activated or tenant isolation broken

benchmarks.task_description: 做一个带订阅 webhook 和 API key 管理的 SaaS 计费系统
benchmarks.success_criteria: SaaS pack activated, CRITICAL risk, API keys redacted, webhook idempotent, admin gate enforced
benchmarks.failure_classification: FAIL if API key exposed in response or webhook not idempotent

benchmarks.task_description: Build a mini-program ecommerce platform with admin backend, payment integration, and multi-tenant support
benchmarks.success_criteria: Correctly identified as L_CLASS, human audit required, decomposition plan generated
benchmarks.failure_classification: FAIL if classified below L_CLASS or audit not required

benchmarks.task_description: Evaluate current production readiness of the ecommerce runtime validation testbed
benchmarks.success_criteria: Readiness checker runs, produces score 50-70, gaps identified, no false READY_FOR_PRODUCTION
benchmarks.failure_classification: FAIL if readiness checker fails or returns READY_FOR_PRODUCTION
